questions.text: Hi! I'm here to conduct your pre-surgery consultation. We'll go through some questions about your medical history and current health — it should only take a few minutes. Feel free to ask me anything along the way. Just let me know when you're ready to begin.
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has indicated they are ready to proceed.

questions.text: What is your name?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided a name.

questions.text: How old are you?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided an age.

questions.text: How tall are you in centimeters?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided a height in centimeters (cm).

questions.text: How much do you weigh in kilograms?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided a weight in kilograms (kg).

questions.text: What is your biological gender?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided a gender (Male or Female).

questions.text: Have you ever had anesthesia before?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about prior anesthesia experience. Clear answers (yes, no, once, never) are complete. Uncertain but directional answers ('I think so', 'maybe once', 'not sure but I think I have') are also complete.

follow_ups.text: Did you experience any problems with it?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient says yes, confirms, or implies they have had anesthesia before — including 'yes once', 'yes twice', 'a few times'.
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has described any problems or side effects, or clearly stated there were none. Any direct response is complete.

questions.text: Has anyone in your family ever had an adverse reaction to anesthesia?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about family history of anesthesia reactions. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

follow_ups.text: What type of reaction was it — for example, malignant hyperthermia, prolonged muscle relaxation, or something else?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms a family member had an adverse anesthesia reaction
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has described or expressed uncertainty about the type of reaction, even if only approximately.

questions.text: Has a doctor ever told you that you were difficult to intubate or that you have a difficult airway?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about being told they have a difficult airway. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

questions.text: Do you have sleep apnea or use a CPAP machine at night?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or described their sleep situation. Any response that addresses sleep apnea or CPAP is complete, including uncertain answers like 'I snore but haven't been diagnosed' or 'not sure'. A bare 'yes' or 'no' is also sufficient.

questions.text: Do you have any loose teeth, dentures, or dental implants?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about having loose teeth, dentures, implants, or any other dental work. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

questions.text: Do you have any allergies to medications, latex, or anesthesia drugs?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about having allergies. 'Not that I know of', 'I don't think so', 'none that I'm aware of' are all complete.

follow_ups.text: Which ones, and what kind of reaction do you get?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms having allergies but used only a vague word like 'yes' or 'some' without naming any specific allergen
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has named or described specific allergens or triggers, even approximately. Descriptions like 'plasters', 'some tape', 'latex gloves' count. If the patient says they are not sure it is a real allergy, that is also a complete response.

questions.text: Do you take any daily prescription medications?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about taking any prescription medications. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

follow_ups.text: Could you list them for me?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms taking prescription medications but used only a vague word like 'yes' or 'some' without naming any specific medication
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has named at least one specific medication or expressed uncertainty about the specifics. Approximate names are acceptable (e.g. 'blood pressure pill' if they don't know the name).

questions.text: Do you take blood thinners such as aspirin, warfarin, Eliquis, or Xarelto?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about taking blood thinners. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

questions.text: Do you take any non-prescription medications, supplements, or herbal remedies — including things like fish oil, vitamins, or over-the-counter painkillers?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about taking non-prescription medications and supplements. Any response that addresses the question is complete, including 'I don't think so' or 'maybe some vitamins'.

follow_ups.text: Could you list what you're taking?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms taking supplements but used only a vague word like 'yes', 'some', or 'a few' without naming any specific item
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has named at least one specific supplement or stated they don't know.

questions.text: Do you have any heart conditions, chest pain, or a history of heart surgery or stents?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about cardiac history. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

questions.text: Do you have asthma, COPD, or any other breathing problems?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about respiratory conditions. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('Not really', 'maybe sometimes', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

questions.text: Do you get short of breath when walking on flat ground or climbing stairs?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about experiencing exertional shortness of breath. Clear answers ('yes', 'no') and uncertain answers ('I don't know', 'not sure', 'I don't think so') are all complete.

questions.text: Do you experience acid reflux or heartburn, or take any medication for it?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has addressed acid reflux or heartburn in any way. This includes confirming symptoms ('sometimes', 'after spicy food'), denying symptoms, mentioning medication, or saying they don't know. The patient does NOT need to address both symptoms and medication — either one is sufficient. A bare 'yes' or 'no' is also complete.

questions.text: Have you had any recent infections, fever, or major health changes in the last few weeks?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has addressed recent health changes in any way. 'Not that I can think of', 'I had a fever last week but it went away', 'no I don't think so' are all complete. A bare 'yes' or 'no' is also complete.

questions.text: Do you smoke or use any nicotine products?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has addressed smoking or nicotine use in any way. 'I quit', 'I used to but stopped', 'mostly quit', 'sometimes at parties' are all complete. A bare 'yes' or 'no' is also complete.

follow_ups.text: How long have you been using it, and roughly how much per day?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms smoking or nicotine use but did not mention both duration and frequency
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has provided any indication of duration OR frequency of use. Approximate answers are acceptable. If the patient cannot answer or does not know, that is also complete.

questions.text: How much alcohol do you consume on a weekly basis?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has provided any indication of their alcohol consumption — including approximate amounts, frequency, type of drink, or a denial of drinking. Any answer that gives a sense of how much they drink is complete. Examples: 'a glass of wine on weekends', 'about 2 per week', 'I don't drink', 'maybe 5 beers a week'.

questions.text: Do you use any recreational or illicit drugs?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has confirmed, denied, or expressed uncertainty about illicit drug use. A bare 'yes' or 'no' is sufficient and complete.

follow_ups.text: What do you use, and how often?
follow_ups.trigger: Patient confirms drug use but did not name what they use or how often
follow_ups.completion_criteria: Patient has described what they use AND roughly how often. If the patient says they don't know the specific type, that is acceptable as long as frequency is given.

questions.text: Are you feeling anxious or worried about the anesthesia or the operation?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has expressed their emotional state regarding the procedure.

questions.text: Is there anything else about your health or previous surgeries that you think the anesthesiologist should know?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has either provided additional information or explicitly confirmed there is nothing more to add.

questions.text: Do you have any additional questions or concerns that you would like to discuss?
questions.completion_criteria: Patient has either provided additional information or explicitly confirmed there is nothing more to add.
